description: This file defines the AmqpClientActor class, an Akka actor managing AMQP 1.0 connections using the Qpid JMS client. It handles connection lifecycle, session recovery, resource management, and communicates with child actors for publisher and consumer functionalities within an AMQP messaging system.

classes.name: AmqpClientActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages the lifecycle of an AMQP 1.0 connection, handles session recovery, and manages publisher and consumer actors within an AMQP messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: StatusReportingListener
classes.description: A listener for JMS connection events that updates connection status and logs events for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: JmsConnect
classes.description: Message class for initiating a JMS connection, used internally between actors.

classes.name: JmsRecoverSession
classes.description: Message class for recovering a JMS session, carrying connection and session details.

classes.name: JmsCloseSession
classes.description: Message class for closing a JMS session, used internally.

classes.name: JmsDisconnect
classes.description: Message class for disconnecting a JMS connection.

classes.name: JmsConnected
classes.description: Response message indicating a successful JMS connection with associated connection, session, and consumers.

classes.name: JmsSessionRecovered
classes.description: Response message indicating a session has been recovered, along with relevant session and consumer list.

classes.name: JmsDisconnected
classes.description: Response message indicating a JMS disconnection event.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Akka Props configuration for the AmqpClientActor with a specified connection, proxy, and connection actor.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates the Props configuration for testing purposes, allowing injection of a mock or custom JmsConnectionFactory.
